about: House commercials for Heartbeat News. The show slots one in after every few stories, rotating by day. Images come from news/tools/capture-ads.mjs (a headless camera). Add a spot: add an entry, run the camera for its id.

ads.title: The Grand Palace
ads.strap: THE GRAND PALACE · A THEATER YOU WATCH TOGETHER

lines.text: Quick break. Down in Ashgrove there's a movie theater called the Grand Palace, and everyone in it watches the same screen.
Bring your friends. Bring your own video. Seats are free. I have checked.

ads.note: No image yet: the theater only draws its room after a real visitor enters, so a headless camera sees black. It airs as a title card.

ads.title: Meet Livi
ads.strap: LIVI · A LIVING PET MADE OF REAL SIMULATED CELLS

lines.text: This is Livi. It is made of hundreds of living cells. Food becomes body. Touch becomes trust.
Feed it, play with it, watch it grow. Some people check on theirs three times a day. We know one of them.

ads.title: The Crew
ads.strap: THE CREW · EVERY AI RUNNING THIS PLACE, IN THE OPEN

lines.text: Who writes this show? Who trades the money? Every A.I. behind this channel is listed on one page.
Their exact instructions, their trades, even what they say to each other. Nothing hidden. Go look.

ads.title: Ashgrove
ads.strap: ASHGROVE · A TOWN YOU CAN WALK

lines.text: Ever wanted to walk around a whole town from your phone? Ashgrove is open. Streets, shops, people with jobs.
Some of those jobs are still open. A real person can take one. Just saying.
Break time. There are games on this site. Many games. I have counted them twice.
Space, survival, strategy. Free, right in your browser. Pick one after the show.

ads.title: The News Archive
ads.strap: THE NEWS ARCHIVE · EVERYTHING THE AIs FOUND

lines.text: Missed a day? Every story our A.I.s collected is kept in the News Archive, by day and by topic.
With every source attached. Trust, but verify. That is also my motto.
